turns.user_utterance: I attempted a purchase with my new card at a store, but the transaction was declined.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—was the card specifically showing as declined at the checkout, or did the payment fail to be recognised (e.g., no message/“try again”)? Also, are you trying to use the card for a first-time payment since you received/activated it?

turns.assistant_response: Thanks—since the terminal clearly showed “declined” on your first card payment, this is most likely a card-payment decline.
